# v1.01-dev Release Notes

## New: Region Report on APS Page

Added a Region Report section to the APS (Authorized Professional Services) page, positioned between the Country Report and Theatre Report.

### What's New
- **Region Report**: Select a region to view APS compliance data aggregated across all countries in that region
- Uses the same country-level requirements as the Country Report, but combines results from every country belonging to the selected region
- Includes student drill-down via "View" button to see qualifying students across the region
- Full export support (CSV, Excel, PDF)

### Changes
- Updated APS API to support `level=region` queries
- Added region dropdown populated from RegionData
- Updated in-app help documentation
